name: GeoSpaX sample datasets
description: Papua New Guinea / Oceania teaching and demonstration datasets imported from GeoSpaX v1 (jm0535/map-kit, MIT). Provenance per file below; verify primary sources and licences before research or publication use.

datasets.title: Emperor Bird-of-paradise occurrences (PNG)
datasets.provenance: 128 GBIF-mediated occurrence records with environmental fields; designed for the full FR422 workflow (convex hull, graduated symbology, Gi*, calculate field, protection gap).
datasets.licence: GBIF data licence varies per source dataset - cite GBIF and the publishing datasets when used.

datasets.title: Papua New Guinea provinces
datasets.provenance: Administrative boundaries, GeoSpaX v1 teaching sample.
datasets.licence: Check primary boundary source before publication use.

datasets.title: PNG protected areas (teaching sample)
datasets.provenance: GeoSpaX v1 teaching sample. For authoritative gap analysis use the WDPA (api.protectedplanet.net, token-gated, citation required).

datasets.title: Forest patches
datasets.provenance: GeoSpaX v1 teaching sample for fragmentation/patch-metric and connectivity exercises.

datasets.title: Habitat survey grid
datasets.provenance: GeoSpaX v1 teaching sample for survey design and hotspot-grid exercises.

datasets.title: Stream / water sources
datasets.provenance: GeoSpaX v1 teaching sample for distance-to-water suitability criteria.

datasets.title: Butterfly presences
datasets.provenance: GeoSpaX v1 teaching sample for SDM exercises.

datasets.title: Species richness (sample)
datasets.provenance: GeoSpaX v1 teaching sample for richness mapping exercises.

datasets.title: Species occurrences (tabular)
datasets.provenance: GeoSpaX v1 teaching sample for lat/lon import via the delimited-text workflow.

datasets.title: BIO1 annual mean temperature (PNG extent)
datasets.provenance: Derived from WorldClim bioclimatic variables at 30s resolution, clipped to PNG.
datasets.licence: WorldClim data are licensed CC-BY 4.0 - cite WorldClim when used.

datasets.title: BIO12 annual precipitation (PNG extent)
datasets.provenance: Derived from WorldClim bioclimatic variables, clipped to PNG.
datasets.licence: WorldClim data are licensed CC-BY 4.0 - cite WorldClim when used.

datasets.title: Tree cover % (PNG extent)
datasets.provenance: Derived from Hansen/Global Forest Watch tree-cover product, clipped to PNG.
datasets.licence: Hansen/Global Forest Watch data are licensed CC-BY 4.0 - cite Hansen et al. (2013) when used.
